templates.label: Offline checklist
templates.content:
# Offline checklist

- [ ] Bundled registry loads without network
- [ ] Language assets and registry are present
- [ ] No extension requires a remote service to install
- [ ] External executables are documented
- [ ] Editor, Canvas, and Calc still work offline
- [ ] Release bundle contains only local resources
